topics.name: Release Acceptance Gate
topics.purpose: Define candidate→collect evidence→evaluate profile→review deviations→authorize release acceptance→accept release as explicit lifecycle separate from deployment.

semantics.atomic_rule: Acceptance refers to one immutable exact release candidate.
semantics.evidence_rule: All material evidence/profile/deviation refs are preserved.
semantics.deployment_rule: Accepted release is deployment-eligible only; deployment is a separate runtime/operations workflow.
semantics.authority_rule: Test/conformance pass alone does not authorize release.

invariants.rule: Test definitions, fixtures, results, coverage, simulations and release evidence never become production semantic authority or grant production execution rights merely by existing or passing.
Verification evidence binds exact test/profile/source/runtime revisions and declared environment inputs so a pass/fail result cannot silently float across unrelated versions or targets.
